description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentService class responsible for managing employee attachments in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve, save, delete, and access permission-controlled employee attachment data.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to handle employee attachment data, including retrieval, persistence, and access control.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeAttachmentDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attachments for a given employee and screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific employee attachment by employee number, attachment ID, and optional screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDetails
methods.description: Retrieves partial details of an employee attachment.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves an employee attachment to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee attachments based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Returns an employee attachment if the current user has permission to access the employee, based on role or if it pertains to self.
